name: k6-typescript-framework
description: Enterprise plug-and-play k6 TypeScript performance testing framework

scripts.run: npm run build && k6 run dist/baseline.js
scripts.run:smoke: npm run build && k6 run -e LOAD_PROFILE=smoke dist/baseline.js
scripts.run:load: npm run build && k6 run -e LOAD_PROFILE=load dist/baseline.js
scripts.run:stress: npm run build && k6 run -e LOAD_PROFILE=stress dist/baseline.js
